tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background: the page behind panels, the top bar, calendar days outside the month.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sidebar, panels, cards, table rows, calendar cells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Drawer, menus, default buttons, the selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Board columns, group and table headers, the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row, nav and button hover; the active nav item; neutral tag fill.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, selects, textareas and unchecked checkboxes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers that only decorate; progress-bar track.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (input, checkbox, kbd, outlined tag). At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface, on type-homework and type-assignment; fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on bg and every surface token; idle icons.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, done (struck-through) titles and disabled labels on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and field. Still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, FAB) and the tick on a done checkbox.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline, 2px offset (inset on rows). Never removed.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind the open drawer.

tokens.name: subject-cs
tokens.usage: Computer Science: dot, progress fill, chart bar. A mark, never text.

tokens.name: subject-physics
tokens.usage: Physics: dot, progress fill, chart bar. A mark, never text.

tokens.name: subject-maths
tokens.usage: Mathematics: dot, progress fill, chart bar. A mark, never text.

tokens.name: subject-cyber
tokens.usage: Cybersecurity: dot, progress fill, chart bar. A mark, never text.

tokens.name: subject-other
tokens.usage: Other: dot, progress fill, chart bar. Deliberately grey.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Overdue text and icon on bg, the surfaces and overdue-soft; overdue ring on calendar chips; border of the Overdue panel. Always with the word or the warning icon.

tokens.name: overdue-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the overdue tag and the Overdue panel header.

tokens.name: today
tokens.usage: Due-today text and icon on bg, the surfaces and today-soft. Always with the word or the clock icon.

tokens.name: today-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the today tag and of today's header in the week view.

tokens.name: today-fill
tokens.usage: Solid amber behind today's date in the calendar and the due-today count badge. Carries text; never a bare mark.

tokens.name: on-today-fill
tokens.usage: Text on today-fill.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Done text and icon on bg, the surfaces and done-soft; fill of a ticked checkbox.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the done tag.

tokens.name: type-homework
tokens.usage: Homework tone: the lightest of the three type fills (tags, calendar chips). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: type-assignment
tokens.usage: Assignment tone: the middle type fill. Text on it is ink; subject dots on it take the surface ring.

tokens.name: type-project
tokens.usage: Project tone: the strongest type fill. Text on it is on-type-project; subject dots take the surface ring.

tokens.name: on-type-project
tokens.usage: Text and icons on type-project.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Stat tile values. One size, never larger.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Page title in the top bar; summary counts on Today.

styles.name: text-subtitle
styles.usage: Item title in the drawer; day number in the week view.
styles.sample: Lab report: measuring g with a pendulum

styles.name: text-body-lg
styles.usage: Body text on the phone layout only.

styles.name: text-strong
styles.usage: Card titles, panel headings, selected nav item.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Column headers and sidebar group labels, set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between inline items; card stack gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page top padding; drawer padding; column gap on Today.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Rare: between unrelated groups in the drawer.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on Stats.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Largest gap; only on empty full-page states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, kbd, calendar chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, week-view items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, board columns, the calendar grid.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Subject dots, round task checkbox, badges, progress bars, FAB.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The task drawer only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, date picker and the mobile add button. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Height of a list or table row on desktop.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects on desktop.

tokens.name: control-h-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable on the phone layout.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width on desktop.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar and drawer header height.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Task drawer width on desktop; full width on the phone.
